+name: LUMO learning wonder detail proof
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-learning-wonder-details-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-learning-wonder-${{ github.sha }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  learning-wonder:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    env:
+      LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+      LP_NUM_THREADS: '2'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Exact Godot and immutable source capsule
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p evidence capsule
+          git rev-parse HEAD > evidence/source-sha.txt
+          git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > evidence/source-tree.txt
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0
+          curl -fL --retry 3 -o capsule/godot.zip https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
+          printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 capsule/godot.zip | sha256sum -c -
+          unzip -q capsule/godot.zip -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin"
+          ln -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/godot"
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          git archive --format=zip --output=capsule/source.zip HEAD project.godot icon.svg scripts scenes assets tools
+          cp evidence/source-sha.txt evidence/source-tree.txt capsule/
+          sha256sum capsule/godot.zip capsule/source.zip > capsule/SHA256SUMS.txt
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: lumo-learning-wonder-source-runtime
+          path: capsule/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 7
+          compression-level: 0
+      - name: Import production assets with strict error gate
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/user-data"
+          timeout 480 godot --headless --editor --import --quit 2>&1 | tee evidence/import.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/import.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Existing learning, sharing, Studio and ambience regression
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/unit-user-data"
+          for probe in learning_world_regression learning_sharing_regression learning_studio_regression lumo_dream_ambience_regression; do
+            timeout 150 godot --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy --script "scripts/tests/$probe.gd" 2>&1 | tee "evidence/$probe.log"
+            grep -E 'PASS|0 failures' "evidence/$probe.log"
+            if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' "evidence/$probe.log"; then exit 1; fi
+          done
+      - name: New production scene state and accessibility regression
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/state-user-data"
+          timeout 150 godot --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_wonder_details_regression.gd 2>&1 | tee evidence/wonder-headless.log
+          grep -F 'failures=0' evidence/wonder-headless.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/wonder-headless.log; then exit 1; fi
+          timeout 420 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_wonder_details_regression.gd 2>&1 | tee evidence/wonder-renderer.log
+          grep -F 'invalid_scene_checked=true' evidence/wonder-renderer.log
+          grep -F 'failures=0' evidence/wonder-renderer.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/wonder-renderer.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Existing unmodified real-touch learning captures
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/legacy-capture-user-data"
+          timeout 600 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_world_capture.gd -- --output="$PWD/evidence/learning-images" 2>&1 | tee evidence/learning-render.log
+          grep -F '[LearningCapture] PASS' evidence/learning-render.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/learning-render.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Exact flower geometry, screen bounds and original after images
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$PWD/evidence/wonder-capture-user-data"
+          timeout 420 xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --script scripts/tests/learning_wonder_details_capture.gd -- --output="$PWD/evidence/wonder-images" 2>&1 | tee evidence/wonder-capture.log
+          grep -F 'failures=0 captures=11' evidence/wonder-capture.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' evidence/wonder-capture.log; then exit 1; fi
+          find evidence/learning-images evidence/wonder-images -type f -name '*.png' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > evidence/image-sha256.txt
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-learning-wonder-evidence
+          path: evidence/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+name: LUMO magical native game hub real regression
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-magic-gamehub-portals-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-magic-hub-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+jobs:
+  native-game-hub:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 23
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Install pinned Godot 4.6.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
+          printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" | sha256sum -c -
+          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
+          mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot"
+          chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot"
+      - name: Import original native project including its real 3D assets
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot" --headless --path . --editor --import --quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/hub-import.log
+          if grep -E 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Failed to load script' /tmp/hub-import.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Exercise live Godot scene, route cards, economic village and 3D decoration
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          timeout 90 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot" --headless --path . --script res://scripts/tests/game_hub_magic_regression.gd 2>&1 | tee /tmp/hub-test.log
+          grep -F '[LumoHub] PASS' /tmp/hub-test.log
+          if grep -E 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Assertion failed|ERROR:' /tmp/hub-test.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Capture real rendered 3D hub – phone and Fold landscape
+        env:
+          LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+          LUMO_HUB_CAPTURE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/proof
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0
+          mkdir -p "$LUMO_HUB_CAPTURE_DIR"
+          xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' timeout 240 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot" \
+            --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy \
+            --script res://scripts/tests/game_hub_magic_capture.gd \
+            2>&1 | tee /tmp/hub-render.log
+          grep -F '[LumoHubCapture] PASS' /tmp/hub-render.log
+          if grep -E 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Assertion failed|ERROR:' /tmp/hub-render.log; then exit 1; fi
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import os, struct
+          for name, dims in (("hub_portrait.png", (1080, 1920)), ("hub_fold_landscape.png", (2400, 1080))):
+              path = os.path.join(os.environ["LUMO_HUB_CAPTURE_DIR"], name)
+              with open(path, "rb") as f:
+                  header = f.read(24)
+              assert header[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", name
+              assert struct.unpack(">II", header[16:24]) == dims, name
+              print("PNG receipt:", name, dims, os.path.getsize(path))
+          PY
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-magic-hub-native-logs
+          path: |
+            /tmp/hub-import.log
+            /tmp/hub-test.log
+            /tmp/hub-render.log
+            proof/
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30

+# LUMO 3D Lernatelier: richtige Handlungen werden zu sichtbaren Sternen
+
+Kinder sollen die Magie in ihrer bestehenden Lernwelt erleben, nicht durch zusätzliche Menüs oder unpassende Punktejagd.
+
+- Ein erfolgreich gelegter Rechenwürfel bzw. eine korrekt angeordnete Silbe erzeugt einen kleinen räumlichen Sternenkranz am realen Ziel.
+- Beim wirklichen Beobachten von Wurzel, Stängel, Blättern und Blüte sowie bei Wasser und Sonne reagiert die Pflanze mit demselben Effekt.
+- Falsche Silben und abgebrochene Gesten erzeugen niemals fälschlich eine Belohnungsanimation.
+- Die alte Original-Lumo-Figur, vorhandenen Objekte, UI-Safe-Areas, Lernbewertung, Stimme und Steuerung bleiben erhalten.
+- Eine einzige wiederverwendete 20-Quad-Instanzgruppe; keine Pfadsterne, neuen Lichter, Schatten oder Kollisionen. Reduzierte Bewegung hält den Kranz still, App-Pause stoppt das VFX-Timing.
+- Headless Godot prüft die tatsächliche Produktionsszene, Korrektheit falscher/richtiger Eingaben, alle vorhandenen Layout-/Lernkontrakte und dieselbe 3D-Effektkomponente. Android-API35/37 und Fold7 sind eigene anschließende Freigabestufen.
+
+Der PR baut auf dem separat geprüften Schatzinsel-Effekt auf und verändert weder main noch Familien-APK. Keine UI-Versprechen ohne native Originalbilder.

+# Native Magic integration: PR172 + PR174 on f0c19
+
+## Frozen source decision
+
+This pack connects seven already published source files to **f0c19f9eb69ea330ac5d2b8f9948cb029ca218aa**, tree **40e7a8d073de320865613152f8a027abbe025d51**. Four modified files were assembled by applying the narrow published context hunks at unique matching positions in the immutable base. Every result equals the complete published PR174 blob. Three additional paths are absent in the complete base tree and are added byte-for-byte. No custom product correction was required.
+
+The only files proposed for the repository are under `final-source/`. `source-freeze.json` binds all seven sizes, SHA256 hashes, Git blobs, original base blobs and direct resource dependencies. `integration.patch` is the exact minimal patch. All four modified files contain additions only: every existing line remains in order.
+
+| Native path | Published final Git blob | Bytes |
+|---|---|---:|
+| `scripts/creative/treasure_world.gd` | `703873a3b0fbe7e589c81bf9695fac5ecf43cd63` | 27404 |
+| `scripts/tests/treasure_exploration_regression.gd` | `a2fe8fd1e0a18403c396fb0ff73ec339a34e1a29` | 7475 |
+| `scripts/learning/learning_world.gd` | `c3b1bc8c73cd764724464d8d2fe0413bdba62a96` | 45953 |
+| `scripts/tests/learning_world_regression.gd` | `8e534e78509283679889335255f39a4f7d49bb64` | 23091 |
+| `assets/creative/shaders/treasure_wisp.gdshader` | `63fd420156242d2bea3a5a9d3ec04eac9da4974b` | 867 |
+| `scripts/creative/treasure_wisps.gd` | `2d854c19869a1959f9bbc76b9aa21c1ca8947a80` | 6446 |
+| `scripts/tests/treasure_wisp_regression.gd` | `7f256c202defeeba47c8c96a577065ee2eda16c1` | 3061 |
+
+The producers are [PR172](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/pull/172), head `1b01b08abd4ff2580125d787a6150e10b2fe47b8`, and [PR174](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/pull/174), head `f2edd325142b92a534b06518f66eadad3551412b`. PR174 is stacked directly on PR172. The large divergent comparison from our integration base to PR172 is retained only as original context and was not used as an integration patch. Narrow PR deltas are retained separately.
+
+## Resulting behavior and preserved boundaries
+
+Treasure mounts the bounded guide effect at the actual player position and feeds it the existing available clue locations. It presents one or two paths according to the real quest state, removes solved paths, and celebrates actual discovery or an accepted answer. The existing quest rules, save format, rewards, safe area and HUD geometry are unchanged.
+
+Learning reuses only the celebration batch: `celebration_only=true` prevents the two Treasure guide batches from being created. Accepted token moves and existing plant interactions trigger the effect. Reduced motion and application suspend/resume are connected to the existing lifecycle. The current teacher/PCM/speech and lesson authority remain in place.
+
+`preservation.json` binds 62 unchanged protected base files and the unchanged functions inside the two modified production files. These include the current Village/grain work, original and facial Lumo assets, Safe Areas, C4 return behavior, Treasure title/visibility regression, raster helper and strict probe runner. No binary asset is copied. The known portrait title truncation is not claimed to be repaired.
+
+The existing `tools/validate_nextgen.sh` remains blob `3255c2e6bd6cfd4b7bb6e50e6dc9b4aaf67e5946` with **52 calls and 17 Studio2020 PNGs**. Its complete call sequence is retained in the preservation record. The three existing Learning/Treasure modes receive the additive assertions through their source updates. The new standalone Wisp regression must be attached separately; this pack does not change the 52-mode numbering, deadlines, movie/sidecar requirements or any existing raster roster.
+
+## Separate Magic gate handoff
+
+`gate-contract.json` is the machine-readable command contract. It supplies all arguments, required markers, output paths, isolated save-directory templates and exact Producer job references. Set `GODOT_BIN` to the existing verified Godot 4.6.3 executable and `MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR` to an absolute dedicated directory. Run from the subsequently published combined native checkout and bind that actual commit/tree/clean state; the old base and Producer heads are not substitutes for the new integrated source.
+
+The four delivered command forms, with only executable/output paths parameterized, are:
+
+```bash
+XDG_DATA_HOME="$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/user-data/magic-wisps-headless" \
+  python3 tools/run_godot_probe.py --log "$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/wisps.log" \
+  --timeout 180 --required '[TreasureWisp] PASS' -- \
+  "$GODOT_BIN" --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy \
+  --script scripts/tests/treasure_wisp_regression.gd
+
+XDG_DATA_HOME="$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/user-data/magic-treasure-headless" \
+  python3 tools/run_godot_probe.py --log "$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/quest.log" \
+  --timeout 180 --required '[TreasureExploration] PASS' -- \
+  "$GODOT_BIN" --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy \
+  --script scripts/tests/treasure_exploration_regression.gd
+
+XDG_DATA_HOME="$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/user-data/magic-learning-headless" \
+  python3 tools/run_godot_probe.py --log "$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/learning-3d.log" \
+  --timeout 240 --required '[LearningWorld] PASS' -- \
+  "$GODOT_BIN" --headless --path . --audio-driver Dummy \
+  --script scripts/tests/learning_world_regression.gd
+
+XDG_DATA_HOME="$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/user-data/magic-treasure-rendered" \
+  LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 \
+  TREASURE_EXPLORATION_CAPTURE_DIR="$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/images" \
+  python3 tools/run_godot_probe.py --log "$MAGIC_EVIDENCE_DIR/render.log" \
+  --timeout 420 --required '[TreasureExploration] PASS' -- \
+  xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' "$GODOT_BIN" --path . \
+  --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy \
+  --script scripts/tests/treasure_exploration_regression.gd
+```
+
+Create the referenced directories first, reuse the existing strict importer and preserve `tools/run_godot_probe.py` unchanged. The listed Producer deadlines apply to this separate section only. They do not replace the different established core budgets. Record `source-sha.txt`, `source-tree.txt`, `source-dirty.txt`, `source-dirty-after.txt` and `engine.txt` for the actual combined source.
+
+The rendered exploration probe writes the three existing names `treasure_choose_route.png`, `treasure_garden_first.png`, and `treasure_route_complete.png` to the capture directory. Its source sets a 1280×720 root window. No local PNG was decoded for this pack, so that source dimension is not represented as an independently measured image result. The Producer's `images.json` contains the three basename keys with `bytes` and `sha256`. Its inline image check verifies signature, minimum bytes and hash; a new combined acceptance must preserve the existing stronger raster checks and actual visual review.
+
+## Original Producer CI
+
+The fixed-head API records contain **8 successful workflows and 10 successful jobs** across the two heads, with **91 successful steps and 4 complementary matrix skips**. `ci-evidence.json` lists every actual run/job identity. Full original logs are retained for the two directly relevant Magic jobs; no claim of full-log inspection is made for the other jobs.
+
+| Head / run | Actual direct job | Original result |
+|---|---|---|
+| PR172 `1b01b08` / [43574914204](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/actions/runs/43574914204) | `132386964721`, native-render-qa | Wisp14; Treasure92 headless and95 rendered |
+| PR174 `f2edd325` / [43575163668](https://github.com/Ullmann27/lumo-godot/actions/runs/43575163668) | `132387709703`, actual-learning-runtime | Learning5347 and Wisp14 headless |
+
+The PR172 render log preserves three graphics warnings: unsupported VSync change, screen-space AA unsupported on the compatibility renderer, and volumetric fog unsupported on that renderer. They are retained in the raw log and separately identified in the derived summary. No runtime ERROR prefix was found in the two original logs; command-echo strings containing ERROR are not treated as runtime findings.
+
+The rendered Treasure result uses the earlier PR172 shared-effect blob. The final PR174 shared-effect source adds Learning's celebration-only mode and has direct headless evidence. Neither result is relabeled as a combined f0c19/C4-return/Village acceptance. No fresh Learning animation pixel review is claimed.
+
+Artifact metadata is retained for `14105782145` (3,850,317 bytes; advertised SHA256 `d75d200139dac7fc9f48084abe494202d8cd08a176164043d5de28ebeffd489c`) and `14105997353` (13,267 bytes; advertised SHA256 `afe07b6ab6cfab2898aa119a26c95d5f7c4293dd2001e29a14230701a9a7001b`). These artifact payloads were not downloaded. The advertised digest is not a local ZIP/PNG validation claim. Original API responses and both full logs are preserved losslessly with deterministic gzip and raw/stored hash bindings.
+
+## Source performance review and limits
+
+The new effect has bounded geometry: two 16-instance guide batches plus one reused 20-instance celebration batch in Treasure; only the 20-instance celebration batch in Learning. Shadows are disabled on these batches. The shader uses an analytic luminous star without textures, point lights, glow postprocessing or framebuffer reads. Periodic redraw uses an accumulated 1/24-second interval, with immediate redraws on relevant state changes. Reduced motion freezes effect positions; pause stops progression. `set_routes` still creates a small bounded array at each call. These are source observations, not measurements of frame time, fill rate or allocation cost on Android.
+
+There is no 60 FPS, Android, physical-device, audible-speech, visual-receipt or release claim. This pack ran no local Godot/renderer/device tests and changed no worktree, Git index, branch, pin, CI run or Producer file. Root must checkpoint the exact sources before the new combined validation. The separately reported 21-check C4 return result belongs to Root's prior evidence and was not rerun here.
+
+## Storage and verification
+
+`manifest.json` records every pack member with stored SHA256; gzip originals additionally have decompressed sizes/hashes. `SHA256SUMS` includes the manifest. The final check verifies all hashes, all original gzip roundtrips against their retrieval bindings, all seven source Git blobs and the exact patch mapping. No temporary signed download URL or access credential is included. Only compact source/API/log material is retained; no APK, image, asset archive or test-generated cache is added.

+# Original Lumo in the Hub and direct Village host return
+
+## Requirement and verified cause
+
+Heinz's existing requirement is to use the original Lumo character, with no replacement figure or newly generated asset. Visual review of the real integration captures found that the Hub always instantiated `lumo_character.tscn`, a primitive capsule/sphere/box character with a purple hoodie. That selection was unconditional. It was neither a selected child avatar nor a failed load of the genuine model. Merely naming this node `OriginalAnimatedLumo` had not proved asset identity.
+
+This targeted patch starts from `7d53f29e68269c21d1d5a66bdf3d488f8e886970` (tree `6f835356946d53c665cf235cd0c26071fdf643ee`). It changes two production scripts, strengthens existing tests and the existing Discovery checker, and adds one test-only identity inspector. It does not introduce or change any character asset or the shared rig adapter.
+
+## Hub behavior
+
+`game_hub.gd` now instantiates the same `lumo_rigged_actor.gd` used by the learning world. Its real imported resource is `res://assets/characters/lumo_facial/Lumo-Facial-Mobile.glb`, with the actual 65-bone skeleton, 9original clips and 2 bound body/facial meshes containing24,027 vertices. The existing eyelid adapter hides its eyelid mesh between blinks; the visible original body contributes21,659 vertices in these captures.
+
+The camera fits the full authored mesh bounds, with idle-motion clearance, into the existing free Hero control. Depth-aware projection correction keeps the full figure above the controls. This adjustment runs on layout changes, not every animation frame. ReducedMotion reaches the original rig; application pause/resume preserves that preference. All 8 existing portal destinations, profile selectors and the original Back callback remain in place.
+
+Both original Hub captures remain 1080×1920 and2400×1080, with their existing filenames and PASS marker. The actual capture asserts the imported GLB, adapter,65 bones,9 clips, bound skin resources, visible geometry, projected containment and separation from Back/profile/portal controls. It writes `hub-original-identity.json` from actual loaded objects and control rectangles. The existing 38-PNG Discovery verifier now requires this file and validates it; it also rejects missing, primitive, wrong-resource, clipped and overlaid identity records. The existing 10-probe/38-PNG contract and result-record shape remain unchanged.
+
+The landscape original shows all 8 portals fully. The portrait original shows 6 complete cards; the last 2 continue within the existing scroll area. We do not claim all 8 are fully visible in the initial portrait viewport.
+
+## Direct Village host return
+
+The direct Flutter→Village entry previously had only a Village→Bauwelt return. Actual `HostBridge.is_embedded()` and its validated launch scene `settlement`/livingVillage select the new direct context. Only that context changes the existing visible return control to `‹ Spiele`, saving first and using the existing `SceneRouter.goto("games")` / HostBridge acknowledgement path. AndroidBack continues to pause. The existing Bauwelt route remains reachable through the extra `Zur Bauwelt` pause-menu button. Native Hub/Bauwelt entries retain `‹ Bauwelt`.
+
+The VillageHost regression instantiates the production scene for both contexts. It verifies that a failed save blocks return, a JNI integer 0 acknowledgement keeps the scene and permits retry, integer 1 preserves the host session/destination, the saved child/slot state restores through the real canonical state parser, and returning does not change progress. JSON numbers are restored to the model's canonical integer form before exact snapshot comparison.
+
+After the actual landscape, UI, plot rebuild, resident sync, camera and layout initialization, `[VillageHostReady]` reports actual values: scene_file_path, mode, living_village, save_path, slot, model plots/population, visible resident count, initialized plot-node count, save_blocked and the selected host_entry/return_scene. These are runtime values, not expected launch assertions. A ready marker alone is not a rendered Android UI result: the separately coordinated Android probe must bind this marker to its actual launched native PID, genuine screenshot and acknowledged visible return.

+# Learning wonder details — execution record
+
+## Accepted direction
+Continue Heinz's original LUMO in the actual native learning route, not an independent HTML or concept image. Preserve original fox, learning controls, answers, profiles, handwriting, journal and saved rewards. Base is the existing ambience work at 9d7d1e3c1696fa7485e2079f3d14c5e7acf3ef35, not a competing particle system.
+
+## Implementation
+A small `learning_wonder_world.gd` extends the original learning class, attaches the reactive garden to the existing atelier after its normal initialization, and provides landscape camera headroom. The production `learning_world.tscn` route points to that extension. **Original learning_world.gd, learning_atelier.gd, learning_activity.gd and the original fox are unchanged.**
+
+The new garden observes actual activity state. Seven bounded MultiMesh geometry batches form copper planters, leaves and 35 hinged petals. The existing two-batch LumoDreamAmbience supplies the decorative particles/butterflies. Numbers, syllables and plant discovery have separate palettes. Decorative progress does not write answers, mastery, profile data, speech or rewards. An invalid activity does not allocate decorative geometry. Reduced motion retains static task feedback; suspension and SceneTree pause stop the local shader clock.
+
+## Test-first evidence and rulings
+- Original missing-route assertion failed before implementation in local exact-capsule source and GitHub run43574150201. Its unchanged existing learning-image job succeeded, preserving the baseline.
+- Actual renderer inspection found flowers behind the landscape header. A projected-bounds assertion reproduced that failure; landscape framing was corrected rather than hiding flowers.
+- Portrait hundred flowers originally fell behind the footer. Exact-geometry projection reproduced this with 10 failures; those flowers moved to the side border, leaving original hundred-stock and source labels intact.
+- Ruling: use a short scene extension, not a rewrite of the large learning class or the concurrent team's atelier. This keeps integration additive and preserves every base learning method.
+- Ruling: validate flower projection using actual mesh vertices plus the petal shader's linear hinge transform. A cube combining mutually impossible extreme deflections caused false positives; actual-geometry checks remain strict.
+- Baseline invalid-scene disposal emits two material-null errors under Godot's dummy headless renderer. The exact baseline was reproduced independently. The invalid production route is therefore tested in the mandatory real-renderer regression, where those errors do not occur; they are not filtered from logs or silently relabelled as fixed.
+
+## Verification contract
+Run original learning, sharing, Studio and ambience regressions; new state/accessibility tests headless and with the real renderer; all 25 unmodified real-touch learning captures; and 11 new renderer captures with per-vertex bounds, dimensions, state metadata and hashes. Require zero SCRIPT ERROR, Parse Error or ERROR lines in these gates. Preserve ordinary renderer-compatibility warnings as evidence.
+
+## Scope limits
+No Flutter pin update, production APK/AAB, Play publication, physical Fold7/FPS/thermal claim, all-grade content review or full application visual approval. General Kart/full-project tests remain separate from the learning change; a local full-suite attempt reached the existing Kart pause-layout test but hit its time limit on software rendering. Do not present that attempt as a full-suite PASS. The final native SHA must pass integration/Android acceptance before any APK includes it.

+extends Node3D
+## Purely decorative, budgeted real 3D meshes behind the original Lumo fox.
+## Does not touch saved game state, gameplay physics or Android permissions.
+var reduced_motion := false
+var _clock := 0.0
+var _arch_orbit: Node3D
+var _firefly_orbit: Node3D
+var _ground_disc: MeshInstance3D
+
+
+func set_reduced_motion(enabled: bool) -> void:
+	reduced_motion = enabled
+	set_process(not enabled)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_build_portal()
+	set_process(not reduced_motion)
+
+
+func _material(color: Color, glow: float = 0.0) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var result := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	result.albedo_color = color
+	result.roughness = 0.35
+	result.metallic = 0.22
+	if glow > 0.0:
+		result.emission_enabled = true
+		result.emission = color
+		result.emission_energy_multiplier = glow
+	return result
+
+
+func _ring(
+	parent: Node3D, name_value: String, inner: float, outer: float,
+	location: Vector3, material: Material
+) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mesh := TorusMesh.new()
+	mesh.inner_radius = inner
+	mesh.outer_radius = outer
+	mesh.rings = 56
+	mesh.ring_segments = 8
+	var node := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	node.name = name_value
+	node.mesh = mesh
+	node.material_override = material
+	node.position = location
+	node.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	parent.add_child(node)
+	return node
+
+
+func _build_portal() -> void:
+	# A small landing platform supports Lumo's feet without hiding his model.
+	var platform_mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
+	platform_mesh.top_radius = 2.35
+	platform_mesh.bottom_radius = 2.5
+	platform_mesh.height = 0.12
+	platform_mesh.radial_segments = 48
+	_ground_disc = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_ground_disc.name = "LumoLandingIsland"
+	_ground_disc.mesh = platform_mesh
+	_ground_disc.position = Vector3(0, -0.39, -0.35)
+	_ground_disc.material_override = _material(Color("224863"))
+	add_child(_ground_disc)
+	_ring(
+		self, "LumoLandingGlow", 2.27, 2.34, Vector3(0, -0.32, -0.35),
+		_material(Color("65e9f7"), 1.15)
+	)
+	_arch_orbit = Node3D.new()
+	_arch_orbit.name = "DreamArchOrbit"
+	_arch_orbit.position = Vector3(0, 1.32, -1.7)
+	add_child(_arch_orbit)
+	var arch := _ring(
+		_arch_orbit, "LumoDreamPortalRing", 1.55, 1.66, Vector3.ZERO,
+		_material(Color("70e8ff"), 1.5)
+	)
+	arch.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
+	var second := _ring(
+		_arch_orbit, "LumoGoldPortalRing", 1.83, 1.89, Vector3(0, 0, -0.1),
+		_material(Color("ffcf78"), 1.25)
+	)
+	second.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
+	_firefly_orbit = Node3D.new()
+	_firefly_orbit.name = "DreamFireflyOrbit"
+	_arch_orbit.add_child(_firefly_orbit)
+	var glow_sphere := SphereMesh.new()
+	glow_sphere.radius = 0.05
+	glow_sphere.height = 0.1
+	glow_sphere.radial_segments = 8
+	glow_sphere.rings = 4
+	var instancing := MultiMesh.new()
+	instancing.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	instancing.mesh = glow_sphere
+	instancing.instance_count = 28
+	for index in range(instancing.instance_count):

+		var position := Vector3(

+			sin(angle) * radius,

+	fireflies.name = "LumoDreamFireflies"

+	fireflies.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	_firefly_orbit.add_child(fireflies)
+	# Two short shoreline lanterns add real parallax without extra textures.

+	lamp_mesh.height = 0.34
+	lamp_mesh.radial_segments = 12
+	lamp_mesh.rings = 6

+extends RefCounted
+## One native entrance per playable Godot world. Flutter host game tiles remain
+## independent and retain their original routing, saves and child identities.
+const ENTRIES: Array[Dictionary] = [
+	{"destination": "kart", "title": "LUMO KART", "subtitle": "Sonnenhafen-Cup", "accent": "ffc94a", "featured": true},
+	{"destination": "settlement", "title": "DORF & WIRTSCHAFT", "subtitle": "Dein lebendiges Dorf", "accent": "91efbd", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "jump", "title": "WOLKENINSELN", "subtitle": "Hüpfen & Entdecken", "accent": "53ddfd", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "puzzle", "title": "PUZZLE-ATELIER", "subtitle": "Bilder zum Leben erwecken", "accent": "c4a7ff", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "treasure", "title": "SCHATZSUCHE", "subtitle": "Das Inselgeheimnis", "accent": "ffd18d", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "rhythm", "title": "RHYTHM PARTY", "subtitle": "Spielen zum Beat", "accent": "ff9fd2", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "build", "title": "BAUWELT", "subtitle": "Bauen & Gestalten", "accent": "88eeb2", "featured": false},
+	{"destination": "stars", "title": "STERNENJAGD", "subtitle": "Sterne entdecken", "accent": "b99bff", "featured": false},
+]
+
+
+static func launch_options_for(
+	destination: String, original: Dictionary, grade: int, subject: String
+) -> Dictionary:
+	var known := false
+	for portal in ENTRIES:
+		if portal.destination == destination:
+			known = true
+			break
+	if not known:
+		return {}
+	var options: Dictionary = original.duplicate(true)
+	options["grade"] = clampi(grade, 1, 4)
+	options["subject"] = "Deutsch" if subject == "Deutsch" else "Mathematik"
+	if destination == "settlement":
+		options["settlementMode"] = "settlement"
+		options["livingVillage"] = true
+	return options

+func _ready() -> void:
+	name = "LearningWonderGarden"
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE
+	_world = get_parent().get_parent() as Node3D

+		set_process(false)
+		return

+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_world) or _activity == null:
+		return
+	_sync_motion()
+	if _suspended:
+		return
+	_observe_activity(false)
+	if not is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	var next: float = (
+		_progress if _reduced_motion
+		else move_toward(_display_progress, _progress, clampf(delta, 0.0, 0.1) * 2.4)
+	)
+	if not is_equal_approx(next, _display_progress):
+		_display_progress = next
+		_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("progress", _display_progress)
+
+
+func _sync_motion(force := false) -> void:
+	_reduced_motion = bool(_world.get("reduced_motion"))
+	_suspended = bool(_world.get("suspended"))
+	var frozen := _reduced_motion or _suspended or not is_visible_in_tree()
+	if is_instance_valid(_ambience) and (force or frozen != _last_frozen):
+		# The learning scene's actual options, not an unrelated router default,
+		# own accessibility. Pause retains the static composition.
+		_ambience.set_reduced_motion(frozen)
+	_last_frozen = frozen
+
+
+func _observe_activity(instant: bool) -> void:
+	var current_kind: String = str(_activity.get("kind"))
+	var valid := current_kind != "invalid"
+	visible = valid
+	if current_kind != _kind or _family.is_empty():
+		_kind = current_kind
+		_size = Vector2.ZERO
+		_apply_theme()
+	var completed := 0
+	var total := 1
+	if _kind == "plant_parts":
+		completed = int(_activity.get("watered")) + int(_activity.get("sunlight"))
+		completed += _activity.get("inspected").size()
+		total = 6
+	elif valid:
+		completed = _activity.get("placed").size()
+		total = maxi(1, int(_activity.call("goal_count")))
+	_progress = clampf(float(completed) / float(total), 0.0, 1.0) if valid else 0.0
+	if valid and bool(_activity.call("is_complete")):
+		_progress = 1.0
+	if instant or _reduced_motion or _progress < _display_progress:
+		# Reset is immediate; revisiting an explanation never inherits a bloom.
+		_display_progress = _progress
+		_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("progress", _display_progress)
+	var viewport_size := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
+	if viewport_size != _size:
+		_size = viewport_size
+		_position_geometry(viewport_size.x < viewport_size.y * 0.95)
+
+
+func _apply_theme() -> void:
+	_family = "nature" if _kind == "plant_parts" else ("language" if _kind == "syllables" else "numbers")
+	var warm := Color("eeb86a")
+	var cool := Color("62c2c2")
+	if _family == "language":
+		warm = Color("eaa0b9")
+		cool = Color("a9a2df")
+	elif _family == "nature":
+		warm = Color("f0ce70")
+		cool = Color("8fce8e")
+	_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("warm_color", warm)
+	_petal_material.set_shader_parameter("cool_color", cool)
+	_pollen_material.albedo_color = Color("ffcf7c")
+	_pollen_material.emission = warm
+	_theme_changes += 1
+
+
+func _material(color: Color, metallic := 0.0) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	material.albedo_color = color
+	material.metallic = metallic
+	material.roughness = 0.76
+	material.metallic_specular = 0.18
+	return material
+
+
+func _cylinder(top: float, bottom: float, height: float) -> CylinderMesh:
+	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
+	mesh.top_radius = top
+	mesh.bottom_radius = bottom
+	mesh.height = height
+	mesh.radial_segments = 12
+	return mesh
+
+
+func _sphere() -> SphereMesh:
+	var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
+	mesh.radius = 0.5
+	mesh.height = 1.0
+	mesh.radial_segments = 12
+	mesh.rings = 6
+	return mesh
+
+
+func _batch(label: String, mesh: Mesh, material: Material, count: int, custom := false) -> MultiMeshInstance3D:
+	var multi := MultiMesh.new()
+	multi.transform_format = MultiMesh.TRANSFORM_3D
+	multi.use_custom_data = custom
+	multi.mesh = mesh
+	multi.instance_count = count
+	var node := MultiMeshInstance3D.new()
+	node.name = label
+	node.multimesh = multi
+	node.material_override = material
+	node.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(node)
+	_batches.append(node)
+	return node
+
+
+func _build_geometry() -> void:
+	_petal_material = ShaderMaterial.new()
+	_petal_material.shader = PETAL_SHADER
+	_pollen_material = _material(Color("ffcf7c"))
+	_pollen_material.emission_enabled = true
+	_pollen_material.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.12
+	_batch("CopperPlanters", _cylinder(0.26, 0.18, 0.3), _material(Color("ad7a51"), 0.08), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("PlanterRims", _cylinder(0.28, 0.28, 0.055), _material(Color("d8b17c"), 0.12), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("GardenSoil", _cylinder(0.235, 0.235, 0.025), _material(Color("384e41")), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("LivingStems", _cylinder(0.027, 0.037, 0.4), _material(Color("54896c")), FLOWERS)
+	_batch("GardenLeaves", _sphere(), _material(Color("74ab86")), FLOWERS * 2)
+	var surface := SurfaceTool.new()
+	surface.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	surface.append_from(_sphere(), 0, Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(Vector3(0.48, 0.075, 0.23)), Vector3(0.24, 0, 0)))
+	_batch("OpeningPetals", surface.commit(), _petal_material, FLOWERS * PETALS, true)
+	_batch("WarmPollen", _sphere(), _pollen_material, FLOWERS)
+
+
+func _position_geometry(portrait: bool) -> void:
+	_positions.clear()
+	for flower in range(FLOWERS):
+		var x := (-0.65 + float(flower) * 0.70) if portrait else (-2.15 + float(flower) * 1.05)
+		var z := -3.85 if _kind == "syllables" and not portrait else -3.55
+		# Leave the rear-right hundred-stock and the lower source label clear.
+		# A side border fits the phone instead of placing flowers behind its HUD.
+		if portrait and _kind == "bridge_hundred":
+			x = -2.65
+			z = -2.8 + float(flower) * 1.55
+		var at := Vector3(x, 0.0, z)
+		_positions.append(at)
+		_set_instance(0, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.15, 0))
+		_set_instance(1, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.30, 0))
+		_set_instance(2, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.332, 0))
+		_set_instance(3, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.50, 0))
+		for leaf in range(2):
+			var side := -1.0 if leaf == 0 else 1.0
+			var basis_value := Basis(Vector3.FORWARD, side * 0.4).scaled(Vector3(0.24, 0.055, 0.10))
+			_set_instance(4, flower * 2 + leaf, at + Vector3(side * 0.1, 0.48 + float(leaf) * 0.1, 0), basis_value)
+		for petal in range(PETALS):
+			var index := flower * PETALS + petal
+			_set_instance(5, index, at + Vector3(0, 0.72, 0))
+			_batches[5].multimesh.set_instance_custom_data(index, Color(float(flower), float(petal) / float(PETALS), float(flower % 2), 1.0))
+		_set_instance(6, flower, at + Vector3(0, 0.735, 0), Basis.from_scale(Vector3(0.17, 0.13, 0.17)))
+	for node in _batches:
+		# Covers both bud and fully open shader-deformed petals in either layout.
+		node.multimesh.custom_aabb = AABB(Vector3(-3.2, -0.1, -4.4), Vector3(6.4, 1.6, 8.9))
+	_layout_changes += 1
+
+
+func _set_instance(batch: int, index: int, at: Vector3, basis_value := Basis.IDENTITY) -> void:
+	_batches[batch].multimesh.set_instance_transform(index, Transform3D(basis_value, at))
+
+
+func render_state() -> Dictionary:
+	var ambience_state: Dictionary = _ambience.render_state() if is_instance_valid(_ambience) else {}
+	return {
+		"kind": _kind, "family": _family, "progress": _progress,
+		"display_progress": _display_progress, "reduced_motion": _reduced_motion,
+		"suspended": _suspended, "flowers": FLOWERS, "petals": FLOWERS * PETALS,
+		"geometry_batches": _batches.size(), "ambience": ambience_state,
+		"layout_changes": _layout_changes, "theme_changes": _theme_changes,
+		"writes_learning_state": false,
+	}

+## Screenshots from the real Godot scene, not prerendered design mockups.
+var output_dir := ""
+const IDENTITY = preload("res://scripts/tests/helpers/game_hub_original_identity.gd")
+
+
+func _initialize() -> void:
+	call_deferred("_run")
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	output_dir = OS.get_environment("LUMO_HUB_CAPTURE_DIR")
+	if output_dir.is_empty() or DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(output_dir) != OK:
+		printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Missing writable evidence directory")
+		quit(1)
+		return
+	root.get_node("SceneRouter").launch_options = {
+		"grade": 2, "subject": "Mathematik",
+		"childKey": "capture-no-production-save", "reduceAnimations": false
+	}
+	root.size = Vector2i(1080, 1920)
+	var packed := load("res://scenes/games/game_hub.tscn") as PackedScene
+	if packed == null:
+		printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Native games scene could not be imported")
+		quit(1)
+		return
+	var hub: Node = packed.instantiate()
+	root.add_child(hub)
+	var evidence: Array[Dictionary] = []
+	for spec in [
+		{"size": Vector2i(1080, 1920), "name": "hub_portrait.png"},
+		{"size": Vector2i(2400, 1080), "name": "hub_fold_landscape.png"},
+	]:
+		root.size = spec.size
+		for frame in range(32):
+			await process_frame
+		var identity: Dictionary = IDENTITY.inspect(hub)
+		if not identity.failures.is_empty():
+			printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Original identity failed: ", identity.failures)
+			quit(1)
+			return
+		var bounds: Rect2 = IDENTITY.projected_mesh_bounds(hub)
+		var hero := hub.find_child("OriginalFox3DHeroSpace", true, false) as Control
+		if not bounds.has_area() or not hero.get_global_rect().encloses(bounds):
+			printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Original fox is outside its free hero area: ", bounds,
+				" hero=", hero.get_global_rect())
+			quit(1)
+			return
+		var controls := {}
+		for control_name in ["ReturnToHome", "ExistingLearningOptions", "LiveGameRoutes"]:
+			var control := hub.find_child(control_name, true, false) as Control
+			if control == null or control.get_global_rect().intersects(bounds):
+				printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Original fox overlaps required controls: ", control_name)
+				quit(1)
+				return
+			controls[control_name] = _rect_values(control.get_global_rect())
+		var actual: Image = root.get_texture().get_image()
+		if actual == null or actual.is_empty():
+			printerr("[LumoHubCapture] GPU failed to return a rendered frame")
+			quit(1)
+			return
+		if actual.get_size() != spec.size:
+			printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Wrong rendered dimensions: ", actual.get_size())
+			quit(1)
+			return
+		var path := output_dir.path_join(spec.name)
+		if actual.save_png(path) != OK:
+			printerr("[LumoHubCapture] Cannot write original screenshot ", path)
+			quit(1)
+			return
+		print("[LumoHubCapture] screenshot ", spec.name, " ", spec.size)
+		identity["png"] = str(spec.name)
+		identity["pixels"] = [spec.size.x, spec.size.y]
+		identity["viewport"] = [root.get_visible_rect().size.x, root.get_visible_rect().size.y]
+		identity["hero_rect"] = _rect_values(hero.get_global_rect())
+		identity["projected_mesh_rect"] = _rect_values(bounds)
+		identity["control_rects"] = controls

+func _rect_values(value: Rect2) -> Array[float]:

+extends RefCounted
+## Inspect the actual loaded resource and skin; a node named Lumo is not proof.
+const ADAPTER := "res://scripts/characters/lumo/lumo_rigged_actor.gd"
+const MODEL := "res://assets/characters/lumo_facial/Lumo-Facial-Mobile.glb"
+
+
+static func inspect(hub: Node) -> Dictionary:
+	var failures: Array[String] = []
+	var result := {"failures": failures, "model": "", "adapter": "", "bones": 0,
+		"skinned_meshes": 0, "vertices": 0, "visible_vertices": 0,
+		"clips": [], "mesh_resources": [], "actual_production_scene": hub.scene_file_path,
+		"headless": DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless"}
+	var actor := hub.find_child("OriginalAnimatedLumo", true, false) as Node3D
+	if actor == null:
+		failures.append("Original Lumo actor is absent")
+		return result
+	var source: Script = actor.get_script()
+	result.adapter = source.resource_path if source != null else ""
+	if result.adapter != ADAPTER:
+		failures.append("Hub must use the same original rig adapter as the learning world")
+		return result
+	if not actor.call("is_usable"):
+		failures.append("The original model did not load a usable rig")
+		return result
+	var visual := actor.get("visual") as Node3D
+	var skeleton := actor.get("skeleton") as Skeleton3D
+	var player := actor.get("player") as AnimationPlayer
+	result.model = visual.scene_file_path
+	result.load_kind = str(actor.get("model_load_kind"))
+	result.bones = skeleton.get_bone_count()
+	if result.model != MODEL or result.load_kind != "imported_packed_scene":
+		failures.append("Hub must instantiate the imported original facial GLB")
+	if result.bones != 65:
+		failures.append("The original 65-bone skeleton is required")
+	for bone in ["Head", "Hand.L", "Hand.R", "Foot.L", "Foot.R"]:
+		if skeleton.find_bone(bone) < 0:
+			failures.append("Original semantic bone is missing: " + bone)
+	for clip in ["idle", "greeting_wave", "celebrate", "point_portal", "agree_nod",
+		"kart_seated", "kart_steer_left", "kart_steer_right", "kart_jump"]:
+		if not player.has_animation(clip):
+			failures.append("Original animation is missing: " + clip)
+		else:
+			result.clips.append(clip)
+	for node in visual.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
+		var mesh := node as MeshInstance3D
+		if mesh.mesh == null or mesh.skin == null:
+			continue
+		if not mesh.mesh.resource_path.begins_with(MODEL + "::"):
+			failures.append("A visible skin is not sourced from the original GLB")
+		if mesh.get_node_or_null(mesh.skeleton) != skeleton:
+			failures.append("Original mesh is not bound to the real skeleton")
+		result.skinned_meshes += 1
+		result.mesh_resources.append(mesh.mesh.resource_path)
+		for surface in range(mesh.mesh.get_surface_count()):
+			var arrays: Array = mesh.mesh.surface_get_arrays(surface)
+			result.vertices += arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX].size()
+			if mesh.is_visible_in_tree():
+				result.visible_vertices += arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX].size()
+	# The existing facial adapter hides its eyelid skin between actual blinks.
+	if result.skinned_meshes < 2 or result.visible_vertices < 1000:
+		failures.append("Original body and facial skin geometry are missing")
+	return result
+
+
+static func projected_mesh_bounds(hub: Node) -> Rect2:
+	var actor := hub.find_child("OriginalAnimatedLumo", true, false) as Node3D
+	var camera := hub.find_child("LumoHeroCamera", true, false) as Camera3D
+	var result := Rect2()
+	var first := true
+	if actor == null or camera == null:
+		return result
+	# Conservative authored mesh bounds include ears, boots and tail. Raster
+	# review additionally checks the actual animated silhouette in both layouts.
+	for node in actor.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
+		var mesh := node as MeshInstance3D
+		if mesh.mesh == null or not mesh.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		for corner in range(8):
+			var point := camera.unproject_position(mesh.to_global(mesh.get_aabb().get_endpoint(corner)))
+			result = Rect2(point, Vector2.ZERO) if first else result.expand(point)
+			first = false
+	return result

+	await _settle()

+		for flower in range(5):

+
+func _flower_bounds(game: Node3D, garden: Node3D, flower: int) -> Rect2:
+	# Project actual mesh vertices and the shader's hinge transform, not a
+	# cuboid containing impossible combinations of maximum X/Y/Z deflection.
+	var found := false
+	var covered := true
+	var result := Rect2()
+	var progress: float = garden._petal_material.get_shader_parameter("progress")
+	for batch_index in range(garden._batches.size()):
+		var batch: MultiMeshInstance3D = garden._batches[batch_index]
+		var count := 7 if batch_index == 5 else (2 if batch_index == 4 else 1)
+		var vertices: PackedVector3Array = batch.multimesh.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+		for part in range(count):
+			var index := flower * count + part
+			var instance := batch.multimesh.get_instance_transform(index)
+			var deformation := Basis.IDENTITY
+			if batch_index == 5:
+				var custom := batch.multimesh.get_instance_custom_data(index)
+				var fraction := clampf(progress * 5.0 - custom.r, 0.0, 1.0)
+				var opening := fraction * fraction * (3.0 - 2.0 * fraction)
+				var hinge := lerpf(1.22, 0.12, opening)
+				deformation = Basis(Vector3.UP, -custom.g * TAU) * Basis(Vector3.BACK, hinge)
+			for vertex in vertices:
+				var local: Vector3 = instance * (deformation * vertex)
+				covered = covered and batch.multimesh.custom_aabb.has_point(local)
+				var point: Vector2 = game.camera.unproject_position(batch.to_global(local))
+				result = result.expand(point) if found else Rect2(point, Vector2.ZERO)
+				found = true
+	_check(covered, "Culling bounds enclose every actual deformed flower vertex")
+	return result
+

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Required after validate_live_connections.sh; keeps the existing 9/7 contract intact.
+set -euo pipefail
+ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+cd "$ROOT"
+LOG_DIR="${LUMO_DISCOVERY_LOG_DIR:-$ROOT/.artifacts/discovery-connections}"

+mkdir "$LOG_DIR"

+export GODOT_SILENCE_ROOT_WARNING=1
+export LP_NUM_THREADS="${LP_NUM_THREADS:-2}"
+
+PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools:tools/tests \
+  python3 -m unittest test_discovery_rasters 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/evidence-checker-tests.log"
+
+probe() {
+  local name="$1" mode="$2" seconds="$3" marker="$4"
+  shift 4
+  local log="$LOG_DIR/${name}-${mode}.log"
+  local -a args=(--path "$ROOT" --audio-driver Dummy --script "res://scripts/tests/${name}.gd" "$@")
+  export XDG_DATA_HOME="$LOG_DIR/user-data/${name}-${mode}"
+  export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$LOG_DIR/cache/${name}-${mode}"
+  if [[ "$mode" == headless ]]; then
+    timeout "${seconds}s" godot --headless "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+  elif [[ -n "${DISPLAY:-}" ]]; then
+    timeout "${seconds}s" godot --rendering-method gl_compatibility "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+  elif command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    timeout "${seconds}s" xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' \
+      godot --rendering-method gl_compatibility "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+  else
+    local rendered="$LOG_DIR/${name}-${mode}-display"
+    python3 tools/run_local_renderer.py --project "$ROOT" \
+      --display "${LUMO_DISCOVERY_DISPLAY:-145}" --output "$rendered" --timeout "$seconds" \
+      -- "${args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
+    cat "$rendered/godot.log" | tee -a "$log"
+  fi
+  if grep -En 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:|Assertion failed|ObjectDB instances leaked|resources still in use at exit' "$log"; then
+    echo "The original discovery probe failed: $name ($mode)" >&2
+    return 1
+  fi
+  grep -Fx "$marker" "$log"
+}

+        result = {}
+        for key, value in pairs:
+            require(key not in result, f"Duplicate JSON key: {key}")
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+
+    def no_constant(value):
+        raise ValueError(f"Non-finite JSON number: {value}")
+
+    result = json.loads(path.read_text(), object_pairs_hook=no_duplicates, parse_constant=no_constant)
+    require(type(result) is dict, "Expected a JSON object")
+    return result
+
+
+def verify_hub_identity(path: Path) -> None:
+    report = read_json(path)
+    entries = report.get("captures")
+    require(type(entries) is list and len(entries) == 2, "Both actual Hub identity records required")
+    require(all(type(entry) is dict and type(entry.get("png")) is str for entry in entries),
+            "Hub identity records need actual PNG names")
+    expected = {"hub_portrait.png", "hub_fold_landscape.png"}
+    require({entry["png"] for entry in entries} == expected, "Hub identity filenames missing or duplicated")
+    model = "res://assets/characters/lumo_facial/Lumo-Facial-Mobile.glb"
+    clips = {"idle", "greeting_wave", "celebrate", "point_portal", "agree_nod",
+             "kart_seated", "kart_steer_left", "kart_steer_right", "kart_jump"}
+
+    def numbers(value, count, label):
+        require(type(value) is list and len(value) == count and all(
+            type(n) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(n) for n in value), label)
+        return value
+
+    def rectangle(value, label):
+        x, y, width, height = numbers(value, 4, label)
+        require(width > 0 and height > 0, label)
+        return x, y, x + width, y + height
+
+    for entry in entries:
+        require(entry.get("actual_production_scene") == "res://scenes/games/game_hub.tscn"
+                and entry.get("headless") is False, "Actual rendered production Hub required")
+        require(type(entry.get("failures")) is list and not entry["failures"], "Hub identity or framing failed")
+        require(entry.get("adapter") == "res://scripts/characters/lumo/lumo_rigged_actor.gd",
+                "Hub must use the original shared actor adapter")
+        require(entry.get("model") == model and entry.get("load_kind") == "imported_packed_scene",
+                "Actual original imported facial GLB required")
+        require(type(entry.get("bones")) is int and entry["bones"] == 65, "Original 65-bone rig required")
+        for key in ("vertices", "visible_vertices", "skinned_meshes"):
+            require(type(entry.get(key)) is int, f"Actual integer Hub geometry required: {key}")
+        require(entry["vertices"] >= entry["visible_vertices"] >= 1000 and entry["skinned_meshes"] >= 2,
+                "Visible original body and bound facial skin required")
+        resources = entry.get("mesh_resources")
+        require(type(resources) is list and len(resources) == entry["skinned_meshes"]
+                and all(type(value) is str and value.startswith(model + "::") for value in resources)
+                and len(set(resources)) == len(resources), "Actual original GLB mesh resources required")
+        actual_clips = entry.get("clips")
+        require(type(actual_clips) is list and len(actual_clips) == len(clips)
+                and all(type(value) is str for value in actual_clips) and set(actual_clips) == clips,
+                "All nine original animation clips required")
+        pixels = entry.get("pixels")
+        require(type(pixels) is list and all(type(n) is int for n in pixels)
+                and tuple(pixels) == raster_roster()["hub/" + entry["png"]], "Hub identity dimensions differ")
+        viewport = numbers(entry.get("viewport"), 2, "Actual Hub logical viewport required")
+        require(min(viewport) > 0, "Hub viewport must be positive")
+        hero = rectangle(entry.get("hero_rect"), "Actual free Hub hero rectangle required")
+        mesh = rectangle(entry.get("projected_mesh_rect"), "Actual projected original mesh bounds required")
+        require(0 <= hero[0] < hero[2] <= viewport[0] and 0 <= hero[1] < hero[3] <= viewport[1],
+                "Hub hero rectangle must be inside its viewport")
+        require(hero[0] <= mesh[0] < mesh[2] <= hero[2] and hero[1] <= mesh[1] < mesh[3] <= hero[3],
+                "Original fox is outside the free hero rectangle")
+        controls = entry.get("control_rects")
+        require(type(controls) is dict and set(controls) ==
+                {"ReturnToHome", "ExistingLearningOptions", "LiveGameRoutes"}, "Actual Hub control bounds required")
+        for name, value in controls.items():
+            control = rectangle(value, f"Actual Hub control rectangle required: {name}")
+            overlap = (mesh[0] < control[2] and mesh[2] > control[0]
+                       and mesh[1] < control[3] and mesh[3] > control[1])
+            require(not overlap, f"Original fox overlaps required Hub control: {name}")
+
+
+def verify(directory: Path) -> list[dict]:
+    captures = directory / "captures"
+    roster = raster_roster()
+    found = {str(path.relative_to(captures)) for path in captures.rglob("*.png")}
+    require(found == set(roster), f"Original 38-PNG roster differs: missing={set(roster) - found}, extra={found - set(roster)}")
+    verify_hub_identity(captures / "hub" / "hub-original-identity.json")
+    images = {}
+    records = []
+    for relative, dimensions in roster.items():
+        path = captures / relative
+        require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), f"Original regular PNG required: {relative}")
+        with Image.open(path) as original:
+            original.load()
+            require(original.format == "PNG" and original.size == dimensions, f"Wrong PNG dimensions: {relative}")
+            image = original.convert("RGB")
+            require(any(low != high for low, high in image.getextrema()), f"Uniform PNG: {relative}")
+        images[relative] = image
+        records.append({"path": f"captures/{relative}", "width": dimensions[0], "height": dimensions[1],
+                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
+    for name, before in images.items():
+        if "-start" in name:
+            after_name = name.replace("-start", "-complete")
+            after = images[after_name]
+            require(ImageChops.difference(before, after).getbbox() is not None,
+                    f"Actual activity did not change its renderer image: {name}")
+
+    report = read_json(captures / "wonder" / "captures.json")
+    require(type(report.get("checks")) is int and report["checks"] == 136, "Original 136 geometry checks required")
+    require(type(report.get("failures")) is int and report["failures"] == 0, "Geometry check failed")
+    entries = report.get("captures")
+    require(type(entries) is list and len(entries) == 11, "Exactly 11 Wonder records required")
+    expected = {name.removeprefix("wonder/") for name in roster if name.startswith("wonder/")}
+    require(all(type(entry) is dict for entry in entries), "Capture records must be objects")
+    require(all(type(entry.get("file")) is str for entry in entries), "Capture filenames must be strings")
+    require({entry["file"] for entry in entries} == expected, "Wonder filenames are missing or duplicated")
+    for entry in entries:
+        name = entry["file"]
+        size = entry.get("size")
+        require(type(size) is list and len(size) == 2 and all(type(n) is int for n in size), f"Invalid size: {name}")
+        require(tuple(size) == roster["wonder/" + name], f"Wrong Wonder dimensions: {name}")
+        require(entry.get("headless") is False, "Original renderer evidence is required")
+        require(entry.get("actual_production_scene") == "res://scenes/learning/learning_world.tscn", "Wrong scene route")
+        complete = "-complete" in name
+        require(entry.get("complete") is complete, f"Wrong original completion state: {name}")
+        garden = entry.get("garden")
+        require(type(garden) is dict, "Actual garden state required")
+        require(garden.get("writes_learning_state") is False and garden.get("reduced_motion") is True,
+                "Garden must observe original task state and preserve reduced motion")
+        for field, value in (("flowers", 5), ("petals", 35), ("geometry_batches", 7)):
+            require(type(garden.get(field)) is int and garden[field] == value, f"Wrong geometry budget: {field}")
+        progress = garden.get("progress")
+        require(type(progress) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(progress), "Finite numeric progress required")
+        wanted = 1.0 if complete else (0.2 if "one-step" in name else 0.0)
+        require(math.isclose(progress, wanted, abs_tol=1e-8), f"Wrong task-linked bloom progress: {name}")
+        kind = "bridge_ten" if "numbers" in name else ("bridge_hundred" if "hundreds" in name else ("syllables" if "syllables" in name else "plant_parts"))
+        require(entry.get("kind") == kind and garden.get("kind") == kind, f"Wrong actual lesson: {name}")
+    return records
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    require(len(sys.argv) == 2, "Usage: verify_discovery_rasters.py LOG_DIR")
+    directory = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    records = verify(directory)
+    source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
+    tree = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}"], text=True).strip()
+    result = {"schema": 1, "native_source": source, "native_tree": tree, "probes": 10,
+              "original_pngs": records, "physical_android_fps_measured": False}
+    (directory / "discovery-connections.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print("[LumoDiscoveryConnections] PASS 10 original probes and 38 verified renderer PNGs")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
